selection_rules: Use the two additional fully cached HO-Cap pickup clips named by the November 11 shortlist; do not choose clips from reconstruction results.
Use recorded camera 117222250549 for every clip, because it is present in all three cached bundles; do not optimize camera choice using geometry scores.
Keep each existing 120-frame window unchanged, preserve original frame IDs, and use the entire 640 by 480 RGB image without cropping.
Train on flat box and the reused development bottle; hold out the entire spatula sequence from representation training and model-selection decisions.
RH20T block is excluded from this split because it is known to occur in world-model training.

Use only source RGB, nominal timestamps, task labels and source provenance as observed method inputs. Training targets must be model-derived; sensor depth and dataset geometry or calibration are evaluator-only.
Seal all model variants and their training provenance before evaluating the heldout sequence. Do not return heldout metrics to active fitting or training agents.
limitations: The historical shortlist and frame windows were annotation-assisted. This is a small, curated feasibility split, not a population-generalization benchmark.
Bottle is a reused development clip and is training-only here.
Box and spatula share subject 9, so this split does not establish subject generalization.
Frame timestamps are nominal original_frame_id / 30 seconds unless original acquisition timestamps are recovered separately; they are not measured sensor clock readings.
Absence of these HO-Cap clips from any pretrained model's training data has not been established.
evaluator_sampling: Source-camera depth and labels at all 120 frames; other recorded views at 13 fixed uniform frames (rounded linspace), with calibration and sequence metadata when cached.
